req.title: Reject malformed player payload
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity when POST /players/ receives a body that fails Player schema validation.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-009 requires POST /players/ to return HTTP 422 when the request body fails PlayerRequestModel schema validation. The PlayerRequestModel has three required (non-Optional) fields: first_name, last_name, position, and squad_number. Tests must cover: (1) a positive case with a fully valid payload that is accepted (EP), (2) negative cases where required fields are missing or have wrong types (NEG/DT), and (3) boundary cases at the exact edge of what Pydantic will accept vs reject (BVA). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting the exact status code 422 (not >= 400), asserting 201 for the positive case, and checking response body structure. Squad numbers used for negative/boundary tests are chosen outside the pre-loaded range (27+) to avoid 409 conflicts.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a fully valid PlayerRequestModel payload (all required fields present and correctly typed)
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, position, squadNumber matching the request
trace: R-PLAYER-009: positive path — valid payload must NOT trigger 422
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Arjun",
        "lastName": "Kapoor",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Arjun"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Kapoor"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body

test_post_player_valid_payload_returns_201()
